summary_en: Kamgras 1 K.K. raised its tender offer price for Kakaku.com from ¥3,680 to ¥3,681 per share on September 29, 2026, extending the offer period by 10 business days to October 14, 2026, for a total of 105 business days. A competing proposal from Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo at ¥3,597 to ¥3,720 per share remains under review by the company's special committee.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment Regarding "Notice of Expression of Agreement with and Recommendation to Tender in Connection with Public Tender Offer for Our Company's Shares, Etc. by Kamgras 1 K.K."
translation_en_brief:
On September 29, 2026, Kamgras 1 K.K., the tender offeror, increased its bid price for Kakaku.com from ¥3,680 to ¥3,681 per share. The company simultaneously extended the tender offer period by 10 business days, moving the deadline from September 29, 2026 to October 14, 2026, resulting in a total offer duration of 105 business days.

This price adjustment was made as Kakaku.com's special committee, established to review the going-private transaction, continues to evaluate competing proposals. Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo (together referred to as "the Proposer") had announced on September 16, 2026 a competing tender offer at ¥3,597 per share, or ¥3,720 if a non-tender agreement with KDDI Corporation could be secured. The two offers are mutually exclusive.

The company's board and special committee stated that they would continue to negotiate in good faith with both Kamgras 1 K.K. and the Proposer to determine which transaction better serves the company's corporate value and shareholder interests, while carefully assessing the likelihood of offer success. The special committee's prior recommendation stance and shareholder discretion regarding participation in either offer remain unchanged.
